Quick note on capacity/credits for the 72-hour window after go-live:

- Per the deal (RDW-2339), Redwood will allocate 2 reserved D-XL nodes for the first 72 hours. If utilization spikes beyond the agreed burst threshold, we will auto-failover to best-effort pooled capacity and alert CardioSense.
- I'll confirm the exact billing/crediting mechanism by Wed 2027-03-03 — but we can offer a one-time usage credit if an outage occurs during the first 72 hours (to be added to SOW).

For the rehearsal: will need a quick 5-minute SLT (service-level test) that exercises model routing and fallback to pooled models. Karthik / Vivek — can you build a 3-step test plan that we can run during the rehearsal?

Subject: Re: Runbook draft — cutover validation checklist attached

Looping in Vivek and Grace for ops and monitoring coverage.

I've added a cutover-validation-checklist.pdf (attached) — highlights:
- Pre-cutover: baseline traffic profile capture, sequence length distribution sampling, KV-cache priming plan. Owner: Karthik.
- Cutover step 1 (traffic switch): route 5% of traffic for 10 mins, verify token latencies are within baseline, then continue ramp. Owner: Vivek.
- Cutover step 2 (smoke): run three canonical queries against production route + verify deterministic outputs and metrics. Owner: Vivek/Karthik.
- Rollback: we will have an automated rollback that flips routing and invalidates new cache entries; need a dry-run during rehearsal. Owner: Karthik.

Attachment: cutover-validation-checklist.pdf
